title: npm user config with registry tokens
whyItMatters: The user npmrc can hold auth tokens for package registries, which allow publishing or private downloads as this user.
notes: Project-level .npmrc files inside repositories are out of scope for this home-folder rule.

cleanup.exportFirst: Save any registry token you still need in a password manager before you revoke it.
cleanup.signOut: Revoke the token this machine used on the registry website, for example npmjs.com > Access Tokens.
steps: Open the file named in the plan and note which registry tokens it holds.
Revoke each token on the registry website, so the copies stop working.
Delete the file named in the plan, then empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Publishing and private installs stop working until you sign in again with a new token.
